title: MoSimple Money
description: Add a Money System to your Multiplayer world.
body:
# MoSimple Money
Add a Money System to your Multiplayer world.

## How to Use
Player commands:
- `/bal`and`/money`to view money
- Ues`/pay <playername> <amount>`to transfer money to another user.

Admin commands:
- Manage accounts with`/eco add:take:set <playername> <value>`
- `/bal <playername>`to view other user money
- `/baltop`to see the users with the most money

## Features
New update 0.0.1-Beta:
- Add money items.
- Add ATM blocks.
- The ATM can deposit and withdraw money.

## Installation
1. Open your `mods` folder.
2. Place `mosimple_money-x.x.x.jar` into your `mods` folder.

## Documentation
We may update our documentation website in the future. The documentation might be merged into our wiki website, which is currently being developed.
